title: Add voidbrain/bricks to the solution and propose its adoption
goal: voidbrain/bricks is a component of the solution, with its contract and first release in docs/SOLUTION.md, and adoption is proposed to each UI project
acceptance: `.solution.json` lists the `bricks` component (repository voidbrain/bricks, emoji 🧱; added 2026-11-25); docs/SOLUTION.md names what it owns and its contract (added 2026-11-25) and the @voidbrain/bricks release each project pins (after bricks:F-004 publishes)
Adoption is planned in each project's backlog (2026-11-25): nerv:F-130, hobo:F-010, grover:F-020, fpvbuddy:F-008 (after fpvbuddy:F-007); the library's own build is planned in its own backlog
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Re-estimated 2026-11-25: the component entry and contract row are done; the pinned release and the adoption proposals remain. Not a measurement.
